paragraphs: I’m a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience building production-grade data and AI systems that turn complex operational data into practical business value. My background spans RAG systems, LLM-powered analytics, machine learning workflows, and scalable data engineering across enterprise environments.

I focus on end-to-end solutions that combine technical depth with business impact — from data architecture and workflow automation to retrieval design, evaluation, and deployment. At NGA Group, I developed AI-driven reporting workflows using OpenAI, LangChain, Pinecone, and Dataiku; earlier at Amazon and Altice USA, I built data quality, forecasting, and ML systems that improved reliability, efficiency, and decision-making at scale.
